sentences.en: After the dog died, they buried him in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 那条狗死后，他们把它埋在了后院。

sentences.en: Feeling the house shake, I ran out into the backyard.
sentences.zh: 感觉到房子摇晃时，我跑到了后院。

sentences.en: The scarecrow in the backyard fell over during the hurricane.
sentences.zh: 龙卷风中后院里的稻草人倒下了。
